$comment: The release evidence gate's configuration, read at the release commit by scripts/dev/release_evidence.py
(the development kit's lib/release_evidence.py, vendored; web/DEPLOYMENT.md, "Release evidence").
tests/test_release_evidence.py holds it to conformance.yml, release.yml and dev.json.
fresh_at_release: route: a tag outside vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (a release candidate, a policy-v tag) reuses nothing and runs the whole repository suite
exact Policy format and agreement corpus (policy-v tags)
release tag, commit, clean tree, artifact pins and Policy tag history (tools/build_release.py)

$comment: The release's evidence job sets the runner up as conformance.yml does (dev.json toolchains, then
scripts/dev/check.sh --setup into .venv) and must resolve exactly this. python-packages is the
environment the checks ran in: requirements-dev.txt pins only its direct requirements, so the
resolved set is compared rather than assumed. jsonschema-formats is pinned: without the
format-nongpl extras the format keyword is not checked and the list is shorter.

jsonschema-formats: import importlib.metadata as m; from jsonschema import FormatChecker; print('jsonschema==' + m.version('jsonschema'), 'formats:', ' '.join(sorted(FormatChecker().checkers)))

pins.jsonschema-formats: jsonschema==4.23.0 formats: color date date-time duration email hostname idn-email idn-hostname ipv4 ipv6 json-pointer regex relative-json-pointer time uri uri-reference uri-template uuid

conformance.$comment: A push to main runs the whole dev.json list and records the job's evidence; pull request runs never count.
conformance.name: Repository conformance
